guide.title: Build a paper bridge
guide.description: A short, hands-on experiment. Keep your checkpoints and compare what changes.

steps.title: Fold a support
steps.text: Fold a sheet lengthwise. Place two books a short distance apart, then rest the paper across them.

steps.title: Test one change
steps.text: Add a small weight. Try a second fold and describe what changes.

steps.title: Keep what you learned
steps.text: Photograph your strongest bridge and record the next thing you want to try.
